integrity: Exact formal-series and Euler-trail proof; finite independent matrix and direct-word exhaustive tests support, but do not replace, the proof.
scientific_limitations: Only complete noiseless multisets of ordered adjacent length-two factors of linear three-symbol words. The existing asymptotic leading constant is not claimed as novel. No efficient construction or longer reads are proved; unindexed equivalent formulas remain possible.
title: Exact ternary length-two multispectrum enumeration and reconstruction code size
